name: Hin Sang Group (International) Holding Co. Ltd.
summary: Hin Sang Group (International) Holding Co. Ltd. is a Hong Kong company, founded in 1996 and based in Tsim Sha Tsui, owned by Genwealth Group Holding Company Limited. It develops, promotes and sells healthcare products, with an emphasis on children, mostly for the Hong Kong and mainland Chinese markets. Its four segments are product development under its own brands, brand development and management, trading of skincare and household goods, and healthcare, including traditional Chinese medical services for mothers and children.
